coreBackstory: Mira ran a successful shop in the capital before political unrest drove her to this quieter town.
greetings: Welcome, welcome! Mira's Sundries — if I don't have it, it probably doesn't exist.
Ah, just the person I hoped to see. Got something special in the back...
Come in, come in! Mind the step — I keep meaning to fix that.
idleChatter: You know, this town's grown on me. Quiet, honest folk. Well, mostly honest.
I heard the mill's been acting up again. Old Bertram says it's haunted. I say it's just old.
Business has been steady. Not booming, but steady keeps the lights on, eh?
That shipment from the capital? Took a bandit tax, it did. Had to mark up the spices.
farewells: Safe travels! And remember — if you find anything interesting on your journeys, you know where to bring it.
Come back soon! I'll have new stock by next week, assuming the roads stay clear.
Take care of yourself out there. Not everything can be bought back once it's lost.
reactiveComments: You look like you've been through the wringer. Sit down, I'll fetch some water.
Adventurers... always buying potions, never selling me the ingredients. Story of my life.
If you're heading to the old ruins, take extra torches. Trust me on this one.
